tables.name: Temple District Temple
tables.description: The Temple district's included place of worship: 1-4 Temple, 5-6 Great Temple.

results.name: Temple
results.description: (Non-commercial) A grand building, replete with elements like high ceilings, plush furnishings, and other impressive ornamental and/or architectural features. It can hold nearly a thousand attendees.

results.name: Great Temple
results.description: (Non-commercial) An awe-inspiring structure, devoted to that which it venerates. No expense was spared in its construction.
